pilot_outcome: Llama recommended 1/6 paired settings; five REVIEW outcomes and erroneous public explanations are retained.

evaluation: One development rerun of the same six settings and optional Qwen example. This is interface development, not a held-out improvement estimate. No repeated prompt tuning or best-run selection.
